stops.name: Achenkirch
stops.quote: Farming traditions and the Sixenhof local heritage museum shape Achenkirch as much as water sports and golf.
stops.english: Farming traditions and the Sixenhof local heritage museum shape Achenkirch as much as water sports and golf.

stops.name: Achensee Nord beach
stops.quote: On the northern shore is the Achensee Nord beach at Achenkirch; at Maurach, the Atoll Achensee has a lake pool with a lawn for sunbathing.
stops.english: On the northern shore is the Achensee Nord beach at Achenkirch; at Maurach, the Atoll Achensee has a lake pool with a lawn for sunbathing.

stops.name: Maurach
stops.quote: The village sits at the southern end of the lake, between the Atoll Achensee leisure centre on the shore and the valley station of the Rofan cable car.
stops.english: The village sits at the southern end of the lake, between the Atoll Achensee leisure centre on the shore and the valley station of the Rofan cable car.

stops.quote: On the northern shore is the Achensee Nord beach at Achenkirch; at Maurach, the Atoll Achensee has a lake pool with a lawn for sunbathing.
stops.english: On the northern shore is the Achensee Nord beach at Achenkirch; at Maurach, the Atoll Achensee has a lake pool with a lawn for sunbathing.

stops.quote: The village sits at the southern end of the lake, between the Atoll Achensee leisure centre on the shore and the valley station of the Rofan cable car.

stops.name: Wusel lake trail
stops.quote: The Wusel lake trail runs for 3.8 kilometres along the eastern shore of the Achensee.
stops.english: The Wusel lake trail runs for 3.8 kilometres along the eastern shore of the Achensee.

stops.name: Pertisau
stops.quote: On the western shore of the lake, Pertisau is a starting point for walks and a landing stage for the Achensee boat services.
stops.english: On the western shore of the lake, Pertisau is a starting point for walks and a landing stage for the Achensee boat services.

stops.name: Vitalberg
stops.quote: At the Vitalberg in Pertisau, you can follow the story of the shale-oil distillers and see how the oil is extracted from the rock.
stops.english: At the Vitalberg in Pertisau, you can follow the story of the shale-oil distillers and see how the oil is extracted from the rock.

stops.name: Strandbad Pertisau
stops.quote: On the western shore, the Strandbad Pertisau has a large lawn right by the water.
stops.english: On the western shore, the Strandbad Pertisau has a large lawn right by the water.

stops.name: Seebergspitze
stops.quote: Walking routes range from easy circuits along the shore to alpine ascents of the Seebergspitze.
stops.english: Walking routes range from easy circuits along the shore to alpine ascents of the Seebergspitze.
